what_it_is.prose: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited (BSE: 543367, NSE: PARAS, ISIN INE045601023) is a listed Indian defence and space OEM headquartered in Navi Mumbai, founded in 2009. The company listed on BSE and NSE via IPO in September 2021. Paras operates two key subsidiaries: Paras Anti-Drone Technologies Private Limited (parasantidrone.com), focused on RF and microwave systems for counter-UAV applications, and Paras Aerospace, focused on drones and drone services. In June 2026, Paras signed an exclusive IP licensing pact with TandemDefense LLC (Powerus Group, USA) for the Guardian-1 high-speed counter-drone interceptor — granting Paras manufacturing and commercialization rights in India. The company also offers a 'Turnkey Laser-based Air Defence Solution' per its 2026 investor presentation. FY26 order book rose to ₹986 crore (from ₹928 crore in FY25), driven by a ₹52.8 crore BEL order (June 2026), ₹26.6 crore MoD order (September 2025), and a ₹528 crore BDL order. FY26 guidance is ₹450-500 crore revenue (per CNBC TV18; Forbes reports $54 million ≈₹450 crore). NOTE: The Atlas register previously listed BSE code 543364 — this is incorrect; the verified code is 543367 per Nirmal Bang, JM Financial, and Shreni.

faq.question: What is Paras Defence's BSE code?
faq.answer: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited is listed on BSE under code 543367 and NSE under symbol PARAS, with ISIN INE045601023. The Atlas register previously listed BSE code 543364 — this is incorrect and should be corrected. The company listed via IPO in September 2021.

faq.question: What is the Guardian-1 counter-drone interceptor?
faq.answer: Guardian-1 is a high-speed counter-drone interceptor developed by TandemDefense LLC (Powerus Group, USA). In June 2026, Paras Defence signed an exclusive IP licensing pact with TandemDefense, granting Paras manufacturing and commercialization rights for Guardian-1 in India. This represents a significant IP import for the Indian counter-drone ecosystem. Production timeline and specific MoD contract value have not been disclosed.

faq.question: Does Paras Defence have a counter-UAS subsidiary?
faq.answer: Yes. Paras Anti-Drone Technologies Private Limited (parasantidrone.com) is a wholly-owned subsidiary focused on RF and microwave systems for counter-UAV applications. Paras also operates Paras Aerospace, a subsidiary focused on drones and drone services. The parent company (Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited) is the listed entity.
